sentences.en: He is as intelligent as any student in the class.
sentences.zh: 他和班上任何一个学生一样聪明。

sentences.en: She is almost as intelligent as an average human child.
sentences.zh: 她几乎和普通小孩一样聪明。

sentences.en: Beautiful, intelligent and hot - this describes what he is not.
sentences.zh: 美丽、聪明又性感——这形容的不是他。

senses.zh: 聪明的; 理解力强的 形容词: intelligential
